039/**
040 * The symbols of a model, the first pass after the parser: a symbol per
041 * clafer, with its UID, its parent, its super clafer, the type of its
042 * reference, its card and group card with the defaults applied, its temporal
043 * modifiers and the clock of its initializer. An enumeration declares a
044 * symbol for itself and one for each literal. The tree is not changed: the
045 * symbols are found by their declarations.
046 *
047 * <p>
048 * The rules are those of the Clafer compiler, in the order it applies them:
049 * the desugarer ({@code Desugarer.hs}: enumerations, clafer uses, a primitive
050 * super, a reference to a constant), the UIDs ({@code UIDs.hs}), the supers
051 * ({@code ResolverInheritance.resolveNModule}, with the relocation of a
052 * top-level abstract clafer that extends a nested one, gsdlab/clafer#67),
053 * the references ({@code resolveOModule}), and the defaults of the cards
054 * ({@code analyzeModule}). A reference's target is resolved as the compiler
055 * resolves it: by a name, a path of names, or a set expression whose type is
056 * the primitive of its values or the nearest common super of its clafers.
057 * The names inside constraints are the next pass.
058 */
059public final class Symbols {
060
061    private Symbols() {
062    }
063
064    /**
065     * An interval of a card or a group card.
066     *
067     * @param low the lower bound
068     * @param high the upper bound, {@link #Unbounded} for {@code *}
069     */
070    public record Interval(int low, int high) {
071
072        public static final int Unbounded = -1;
073        public static final Interval Any = new Interval(0, Unbounded);
074        public static final Interval One = new Interval(1, 1);
075        public static final Interval Lone = new Interval(0, 1);
076
077        @Override
078        public String toString() {
079            return low + ".." + (high == Unbounded ? "*" : Integer.toString(high));
080        }
081    }
082
083    /**
084     * A group card.
085     *
086     * @param keyword whether it was written as {@code xor}, {@code or},
087     * {@code mux} or {@code opt}: a child under {@code opt} is optional,
088     * under a written {@code 0..*} mandatory
089     * @param interval its interval
090     */
091    public record GroupCard(boolean keyword, Interval interval) {
092
093        /**
094         * The group card of a clafer that has none and inherits none.
095         */
096        public static final GroupCard Default = new GroupCard(false, Interval.Any);
097    }
098
099    /**
100     * The modifiers of a reference: {@code finalref}, {@code finaltarget},
101     * and {@code final}, which is both.
102     */
103    public enum RefModifier {
104        FinalRef("finalref"), FinalTarget("finaltarget"), FinalRefTarget("final");
105
106        private final String keyword;
107
108        RefModifier(String keyword) {
109            this.keyword = keyword;
110        }
111
112        public String keyword() {
113            return keyword;
114        }
115    }
116
117    /**
118     * The reference of a clafer.
119     *
120     * @param span the target as written, or the constant of {@code -> 1}
121     * @param isSet whether it is {@code ->}, rather than {@code ->>}
122     * @param target the target as written; for {@code -> 1}, the constant
123     * @param clafer the clafer it refers to, if its type is a clafer
124     * @param primitive the primitive it refers to, as written
125     * ({@code integer} or {@code int}), if its type is a primitive
126     */
127    public record Reference(SourceSpan span, boolean isSet, Exp target, Optional<ClaferSymbol> clafer,
128            Optional<String> primitive) {
129
130        /**
131         * @return whether the reference has one type, a clafer or a
132         * primitive; a union of unrelated clafers has none
133         */
134        public boolean hasType() {
135            return clafer.isPresent() || primitive.isPresent();
136        }
137
138        /**
139         * @return the type as the explicit form writes it: a UID, or a
140         * primitive with {@code integer} as {@code int}
141         */
142        public String typeName() {
143            if (clafer.isPresent()) {
144                return clafer.get().uid();
145            }
146            String p = primitive.orElseThrow();
147            return p.equals("integer") ? "int" : p;
148        }
149    }
150
151    /**
152     * A clafer, or an enumeration or one of its literals.
153     */
154    public static final class ClaferSymbol {
155
156        private final Node declaration;
157        private final Ident name;
158        private final ClaferSymbol lexicalParent;
159        private final boolean isAbstract;
160        private final boolean isEnum;
161        private final boolean initial;
162        private final boolean isFinal;
163        private final List<RefModifier> refModifiers;
164        private final Optional<GroupCard> writtenGroupCard;
165        private final Optional<Interval> writtenCard;
166        private final Optional<Exp> superExp;
167        private final Optional<Syntax.Reference> writtenReference;
168        private final Optional<InitKind> initializer;
169        final List<ClaferSymbol> lexicalChildren = new ArrayList<>();
170        // what the pass finds
171        String uid;
172        ClaferSymbol parent;
173        final List<ClaferSymbol> children = new ArrayList<>();
174        ClaferSymbol superClafer;
175        boolean superResolved;
176        boolean inheritsInitial;
177        boolean inheritsFinal;
178        Reference reference;
179        // the types of the values of the reference, as the compiler's getRefIds
180        List<String> referenceIds = List.of();
181        Interval card;
182        GroupCard groupCard;
183
184        ClaferSymbol(Node declaration, Ident name, ClaferSymbol lexicalParent, boolean isAbstract, boolean isEnum,
185                boolean initial, boolean isFinal, List<RefModifier> refModifiers,
186                Optional<GroupCard> writtenGroupCard, Optional<Interval> writtenCard, Optional<Exp> superExp,
187                Optional<Syntax.Reference> writtenReference, Optional<InitKind> initializer) {
188            this.declaration = declaration;
189            this.name = name;
190            this.lexicalParent = lexicalParent;
191            this.isAbstract = isAbstract;
192            this.isEnum = isEnum;
193            this.initial = initial;
194            this.isFinal = isFinal;
195            this.refModifiers = List.copyOf(refModifiers);
196            this.writtenGroupCard = writtenGroupCard;
197            this.writtenCard = writtenCard;
198            this.superExp = superExp;
199            this.writtenReference = writtenReference;
200            this.initializer = initializer;
201        }
202
203        /**
204         * @return the {@link Clafer}, {@link ClaferUse} or {@link EnumDecl}
205         * that declares it, or the {@link Ident} of an enumeration's literal
206         */
207        public Node declaration() {
208            return declaration;
209        }
210
211        public String name() {
212            return name.text();
213        }
214
215        public SourceSpan nameSpan() {
216            return name.span();
217        }
218
219        public String uid() {
220            return uid;
221        }
222
223        /**
224         * @return its parent, empty at the top level; a top-level abstract
225         * clafer that extends a nested one is a sibling of its super
226         * (gsdlab/clafer#67)
227         */
228        public Optional<ClaferSymbol> parent() {
229            return Optional.ofNullable(parent);
230        }
231
232        /**
233         * @return the clafer whose block declares it, empty at the top level
234         */
235        public Optional<ClaferSymbol> lexicalParent() {
236            return Optional.ofNullable(lexicalParent);
237        }
238
239        /**
240         * @return its subclafers, in the order of the model, with the clafers
241         * relocated under it last
242         */
243        public List<ClaferSymbol> children() {
244            return Collections.unmodifiableList(children);
245        }
246
247        public boolean isAbstract() {
248            return isAbstract;
249        }
250
251        /**
252         * @return whether it is an enumeration or one of its literals
253         */
254        public boolean isEnum() {
255            return isEnum;
256        }
257
258        /**
259         * @return whether its parent is the root, as the compiler's
260         * {@code isTopLevel}
261         */
262        public boolean isTopLevel() {
263            return parent == null;
264        }
265
266        /**
267         * @return the super as written, if it is a clafer: not a primitive
268         * super, which is a reference, nor {@code : clafer}
269         */
270        Optional<Exp> superExp() {
271            return superExp;
272        }
273
274        public Optional<ClaferSymbol> superClafer() {
275            return Optional.ofNullable(superClafer);
276        }
277
278        public Optional<Reference> reference() {
279            return Optional.ofNullable(reference);
280        }
281
282        /**
283         * @return its card, as written or by default
284         */
285        public Interval card() {
286            return card;
287        }
288
289        /**
290         * @return its group card: as written, or else that of its nearest
291         * super with one, or else {@link GroupCard#Default}
292         */
293        public GroupCard groupCard() {
294            return groupCard;
295        }
296
297        public Optional<Interval> writtenCard() {
298            return writtenCard;
299        }
300
301        public Optional<GroupCard> writtenGroupCard() {
302            return writtenGroupCard;
303        }
304

306         * @return whether it is initial, as written or as its super is
307         * written
308         */
309        public boolean isInitial() {
310            return initial || inheritsInitial;
311        }
312

314         * @return whether it is final, as written or as its super is written

316        public boolean isFinal() {

324        public List<RefModifier> refModifiers() {

343    /**
344     * The symbols of a model.
345     *
346     * @param topLevel the top-level symbols, in the order of the model,
347     * enumerations followed by their literals
348     * @param all all symbols, in pre-order of the declarations
349     * @param byDeclaration the symbol of each declaration, by identity
350     * @param diagnostics the errors
351     */
352    public record Result(List<ClaferSymbol> topLevel, List<ClaferSymbol> all,
353            Map<Node, ClaferSymbol> byDeclaration, List<Diagnostic> diagnostics) {
354
355        /**
356         * @param declaration a clafer, a clafer use, an enumeration or the
357         * name of a literal
358         * @return its symbol
359         */
360        public Optional<ClaferSymbol> of(Node declaration) {
361            return Optional.ofNullable(byDeclaration.get(declaration));
362        }
363    }
364
365    static final Set<String> Primitives = Set.of("string", "int", "integer", "decimal", "double", "real");
366    private static final Set<String> Specials = Set.of("this", "parent", "dref", "root", "children", "noclafer");
367
368    /**
369     * @param model a parsed model
370     * @return its symbols
371     */
372    public static Result analyze(Model model) {
373        return new Analysis().run(model);
374    }
375
376    private static final class Analysis {
377
378        private final List<ClaferSymbol> topLevel = new ArrayList<>();
379        private final List<ClaferSymbol> all = new ArrayList<>();
380        private final Map<Node, ClaferSymbol> byDeclaration = new IdentityHashMap<>();
381        private final List<Diagnostic> diagnostics = new ArrayList<>();
382        private final Set<ClaferSymbol> resolving = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
383
384        Result run(Model model) {
385            for (Declaration d : model.declarations()) {
386                declare(d);
387            }
388            assignUids();
389            for (ClaferSymbol c : all) {
390                resolveSuper(c);
391            }
392            checkCycles();
393            relocate();
394            for (ClaferSymbol c : all) {
395                resolveReference(c);
396            }
397            for (ClaferSymbol c : roots()) {
398                analyzeCards(c, null);
399            }
400            checkDuplicateSiblings(roots());
401            for (ClaferSymbol c : all) {
402                checkRedefinition(c);
403                checkGroup(c);
404            }
405            diagnostics.sort((a, b) -> a.span().line() != b.span().line()
406                    ? Integer.compare(a.span().line(), b.span().line())
407                    : Integer.compare(a.span().column(), b.span().column()));
408            return new Result(List.copyOf(roots()), List.copyOf(all), Collections.unmodifiableMap(byDeclaration),
409                    List.copyOf(diagnostics));
410        }
411
412        private List<ClaferSymbol> roots() {
413            return topLevel;
414        }
415
416        private void error(SourceSpan span, String message) {
417            diagnostics.add(new Diagnostic(span, message));
418        }
419
420        // --------------------------------------------------------------
421        // Declarations, as the desugarer makes them
422        // --------------------------------------------------------------
423        private void declare(Declaration d) {
424            switch (d) {
425                case EnumDecl e -> {
426                    // an abstract clafer, and a clafer extending it for each literal
427                    ClaferSymbol en = add(new ClaferSymbol(e, e.name(), null, true, true, false, false, List.of(),
428                            Optional.empty(), Optional.empty(), Optional.empty(), Optional.empty(), Optional.empty()),
429                            null, e);
430                    for (Ident literal : e.literals()) {
431                        ClaferSymbol l = add(new ClaferSymbol(literal, literal, null, false, true, false, false,
432                                List.of(), Optional.empty(), Optional.of(Interval.One), Optional.empty(),
433                                Optional.empty(), Optional.empty()), null, literal);
434                        l.superClafer = en;
435                        l.superResolved = true;
436                    }
437                }
438                case Element e -> declare(e, null);
439            }
440        }
441
442        private void declare(Element e, ClaferSymbol parent) {
443            switch (e) {
444                case Clafer c -> declareClafer(c, parent);
445                case ClaferUse u -> {
446                    Ident name = u.name().path().get(u.name().path().size() - 1);
447                    ClaferSymbol s = add(new ClaferSymbol(u, name, parent, false, false, false, false, List.of(),
448                            Optional.empty(), u.card().flatMap(this::card), Optional.of(new ClaferId(u.name().span(), u.name())),
449                            Optional.empty(), Optional.empty()), parent, u);
450                    u.elements().ifPresent(es -> es.elements().forEach(x -> declare(x, s)));
451                }
452                default -> {
453                }
454            }
455        }
456
457        private void declareClafer(Clafer c, ClaferSymbol parent) {
458            Optional<Interval> writtenCard = c.card().flatMap(this::card);
459            Optional<Syntax.Reference> reference = c.reference();
460            Optional<Exp> superExp = c.superClafer().map(Syntax.Super::exp);
461            Optional<InitKind> init = c.init().map(i -> switch (i.how()) {
462                case Constant -> InitKind.FIXED;
463                case Each -> InitKind.EACH;
464                case Together -> InitKind.TOGETHER;
465                // more than one instance under a parent: together; by the written card
466                case Default -> writtenCard.map(w -> w.high() != 0 && w.high() != 1).orElse(false)
467                        ? InitKind.TOGETHER : InitKind.EACH;
468            });
469            // a reference to a constant, `-> 1`, is a reference to its type with the value `= 1`
470            if (c.init().isEmpty() && reference.isPresent() && constantType(reference.get().exp()).isPresent()) {
471                init = Optional.of(InitKind.FIXED);
472            }
473            // a primitive super, `: integer`, is a reference
474            if (superExp.isPresent() && superName(superExp.get()).filter(Primitives::contains).isPresent()) {
475                if (reference.isPresent()) {
476                    error(superExp.get().span(), "A clafer with a reference cannot have a primitive type as its super: "
477                            + superName(superExp.get()).get());
478                } else {
479                    reference = Optional.of(new Syntax.Reference(c.superClafer().get().span(), false, superExp.get()));
480                }
481                superExp = Optional.empty();
482            }
483            // `: clafer` is no super
484            if (superExp.isPresent() && superExp.get() instanceof ClaferId id && id.name().path().size() == 1
485                    && id.name().path().get(0).text().equals("clafer")) {
486                superExp = Optional.empty();
487            }
488            boolean initial = false;
489            boolean isFinal = false;
490            List<RefModifier> refModifiers = new ArrayList<>();
491            for (TempModifier m : c.modifiers()) {
492                switch (m.kind()) {
493                    case Initial -> initial = true;
494                    case Final -> {
495                        isFinal = true;
496                        if (c.reference().isPresent()) {
497                            addOnce(refModifiers, RefModifier.FinalRefTarget);
498                        }
499                    }
500                    case FinalRef -> addOnce(refModifiers, RefModifier.FinalRef);
501                    case FinalTarget -> addOnce(refModifiers, RefModifier.FinalTarget);
502                }
503            }
504            ClaferSymbol s = add(new ClaferSymbol(c, c.name(), parent, c.isAbstract(), false, initial, isFinal,
505                    refModifiers, c.groupCard().flatMap(this::groupCard), writtenCard, superExp, reference, init),
506                    parent, c);
507            c.elements().ifPresent(es -> es.elements().forEach(x -> declare(x, s)));
508        }
509
510        private static <T> void addOnce(List<T> list, T t) {
511            if (!list.contains(t)) {
512                list.add(t);
513            }
514        }
515
516        private ClaferSymbol add(ClaferSymbol s, ClaferSymbol parent, Node declaration) {
517            all.add(s);
518            byDeclaration.put(declaration, s);
519            if (parent == null) {
520                topLevel.add(s);
521            } else {
522                parent.lexicalChildren.add(s);
523                parent.children.add(s);
524            }
525            s.parent = parent;
526            return s;
527        }
528
529        private Optional<Interval> card(Syntax.Card card) {
530            return switch (card) {
531                case CardSymbol s -> Optional.of(switch (s.symbol()) {
532                    case "?" -> Interval.Lone;
533                    case "+" -> new Interval(1, Interval.Unbounded);
534                    default -> Interval.Any;
535                });
536                case CardNum n -> number(n.span(), n.number()).map(k -> new Interval(k, k));
537                case NCard n -> interval(n);
538            };
539        }
540
541        private Optional<GroupCard> groupCard(Syntax.GCard card) {
542            return switch (card) {
543                case GroupKeyword k -> Optional.of(new GroupCard(true, switch (k.keyword()) {
544                    case "xor" -> Interval.One;
545                    case "or" -> new Interval(1, Interval.Unbounded);
546                    case "mux" -> Interval.Lone;
547                    default -> Interval.Any;
548                }));
549                case NCard n -> interval(n).map(i -> new GroupCard(false, i));
550            };
551        }
552
553        private Optional<Interval> interval(NCard n) {
554            Optional<Integer> low = number(n.span(), n.low());
555            Optional<Integer> high = n.high().isEmpty() ? Optional.of(Interval.Unbounded) : number(n.span(), n.high().get());
556            return low.isPresent() && high.isPresent() ? Optional.of(new Interval(low.get(), high.get())) : Optional.empty();
557        }
558
559        private Optional<Integer> number(SourceSpan span, String text) {
560            try {
561                return Optional.of(Integer.parseInt(text));
562            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
563                error(span, "The bound " + text + " is too large");
564                return Optional.empty();
565            }
566        }
567
568        /**
569         * The type of a constant as a reference's target, as the desugarer's
570         * {@code constantType}: a real literal, {@code 3.14}, is a decimal.
571         */
572        private static Optional<String> constantType(Exp exp) {
573            Exp e = exp instanceof Unary u && u.op() == UnaryOp.Minus ? u.exp() : exp;
574            if (e instanceof Literal l) {
575                return Optional.of(switch (l.kind()) {
576                    case Int -> "integer";
577                    case Double -> "double";
578                    case Real -> "decimal";
579                    case Str -> "string";
580                });
581            }
582            return Optional.empty();
583        }
584
585        /**
586         * The last name of a name or a path, as the desugarer's
587         * {@code getPExpClaferIdent}.
588         */
589        private static Optional<String> superName(Exp exp) {
590            return switch (exp) {
591                case ClaferId id -> Optional.of(last(id));
592                case Binary b when b.op() == BinaryOp.Join -> superName(b.right());
593                default -> Optional.empty();
594            };
595        }
596
597        private static String last(ClaferId id) {
598            return id.name().path().get(id.name().path().size() - 1).text();
599        }
600
601        // --------------------------------------------------------------
602        // UIDs, as UIDs.assignUIDs
603        // --------------------------------------------------------------
604        private void assignUids() {
605            List<List<String>> reversed = new ArrayList<>();
606            for (ClaferSymbol s : all) {
607                List<String> path = new ArrayList<>();
608                for (ClaferSymbol c = s; c != null; c = c.lexicalParent) {
609                    path.add(c.name());
610                }
611                reversed.add(path);
612            }
613            Map<List<String>, Integer> suffixCounts = new HashMap<>();
614            for (List<String> rp : reversed) {
615                Set<List<String>> suffixes = new HashSet<>();
616                for (int k = 1; k <= rp.size(); k++) {
617                    suffixes.add(rp.subList(0, k));
618                }
619                for (List<String> s : suffixes) {
620                    suffixCounts.merge(s, 1, Integer::sum);
621                }
622            }
623            Set<String> used = new HashSet<>();
624            for (int i = 0; i < all.size(); i++) {
625                List<String> rp = reversed.get(i);
626                List<String> chosen = null;
627                for (int k = 1; k <= rp.size() && chosen == null; k++) {
628                    if (suffixCounts.get(rp.subList(0, k)) == 1) {
629                        chosen = rp.subList(0, k);
630                    }
631                }
632                if (chosen == null) {
633                    chosen = new ArrayList<>(rp);
634                    chosen.add("root");
635                }
636                List<String> names = new ArrayList<>(chosen);
637                Collections.reverse(names);
638                String uid = names.stream().map(n -> n.replace("'", "_prime")).collect(Collectors.joining("__"));
639                String fresh = uid;
640                for (int n = 2; used.contains(fresh); n++) {
641                    fresh = uid + "__" + n;
642                }
643                used.add(fresh);
644                all.get(i).uid = fresh;
645            }
646        }
647
648        // --------------------------------------------------------------
649        // Supers, as ResolverInheritance.resolveNSuper
650        // --------------------------------------------------------------
651        private List<ClaferSymbol> abstractClafers() {
652            return all.stream().filter(c -> c.isAbstract).toList();
653        }
654
655        /**
656         * The supers of the clafer, nearest first, without a cycle.
657         */
658        private List<ClaferSymbol> superChain(ClaferSymbol c) {
659            List<ClaferSymbol> chain = new ArrayList<>();
660            Set<ClaferSymbol> visited = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
661            visited.add(c);
662            for (ClaferSymbol s = resolveSuper(c); s != null && visited.add(s); s = resolveSuper(s)) {
663                chain.add(s);
664            }
665            return chain;
666        }
667
668        private ClaferSymbol resolveSuper(ClaferSymbol c) {
669            if (c.superResolved || c.superExp.isEmpty()) {
670                return c.superClafer;
671            }
672            if (!resolving.add(c)) {
673                // a cycle, which checkCycles reports
674                return null;
675            }
676            try {
677                Exp exp = c.superExp.get();
678                c.superClafer = switch (exp) {
679                    case ClaferId id -> superByName(c, id);
680                    case Binary b when b.op() == BinaryOp.Join -> superByPath(c, b);
681                    default -> {
682                        error(exp.span(), "A super must be the name of an abstract clafer or a path to it, e.g., Person.Head");
683                        yield null;
684                    }
685                };
686                c.superResolved = true;
687                if (c.superClafer != null) {
688                    c.inheritsInitial = c.superClafer.initial;
689                    c.inheritsFinal = c.superClafer.isFinal;
690                }
691                return c.superClafer;
692            } finally {
693                resolving.remove(c);
694            }
695        }
696
697        private ClaferSymbol superByName(ClaferSymbol c, ClaferId id) {
698            String name = last(id);
699            if (Primitives.contains(name)) {
700                error(id.span(), "Primitive types are not allowed as super types: " + name);
701                return null;
702            }
703            List<ClaferSymbol> abstracts = abstractClafers().stream().filter(a -> a != c).toList();
704            // a clafer cannot extend itself, unless it redefines another clafer with its name
705            if (c.isAbstract && name.equals(c.name()) && abstracts.stream().noneMatch(a -> a.name().equals(name))) {
706                error(c.declaration.span(), "clafer " + c.uid + " inherits from itself");
707                return null;
708            }
709            // the nearest abstract clafer with the name among the children of the parent and
710            // those the parent inherits
711            if (c.lexicalParent != null) {
712                List<ClaferSymbol> scopes = new ArrayList<>();
713                scopes.add(c.lexicalParent);
714                scopes.addAll(superChain(c.lexicalParent));
715                for (ClaferSymbol s : scopes) {
716                    for (ClaferSymbol child : s.lexicalChildren) {
717                        if (child.isAbstract && child != c && child.name().equals(name)) {
718                            return child;
719                        }
720                    }
721                }
722            }
723            List<ClaferSymbol> candidates = abstracts.stream().filter(a -> a.name().equals(name)).toList();
724            if (candidates.isEmpty()) {
725                error(id.span(), "No superclafer found: " + name);
726                return null;
727            }
728            if (candidates.size() > 1) {
729                error(id.span(), "clafer \"" + name + "\" is not unique. Available paths: "
730                        + candidates.stream().map(Analysis::path).collect(Collectors.joining(", ")));
731                return null;
732            }
733            return candidates.get(0);
734        }
735
736        private ClaferSymbol superByPath(ClaferSymbol c, Binary path) {
737            List<ClaferId> names = new ArrayList<>();
738            if (!pathNames(path, names)) {
739                error(path.span(), "A super must be the name of an abstract clafer or a path to it, e.g., Person.Head");
740                return null;
741            }
742            String text = names.stream().map(Analysis::last).collect(Collectors.joining("."));
743            String first = last(names.get(0));
744            ClaferSymbol s = null;
745            for (ClaferSymbol a = c.lexicalParent; a != null && s == null; a = a.lexicalParent) {
746                if (a.name().equals(first)) {
747                    s = a;
748                }
749            }
750            if (s == null) {
751                List<ClaferSymbol> named = all.stream().filter(x -> x.name().equals(first)).toList();
752                List<ClaferSymbol> top = named.stream().filter(x -> x.lexicalParent == null).toList();
753                if (named.isEmpty()) {
754                    error(path.span(), "No superclafer found: no clafer " + first + " for " + text);
755                    return null;
756                } else if (named.size() == 1) {
757                    s = named.get(0);
758                } else if (top.size() == 1) {
759                    s = top.get(0);
760                } else {
761                    error(path.span(), "No superclafer found: the clafer " + first + " in " + text + " is not unique");
762                    return null;
763                }
764            }
765            for (ClaferId id : names.subList(1, names.size())) {
766                String n = last(id);
767                ClaferSymbol child = null;
768                List<ClaferSymbol> scopes = new ArrayList<>();
769                scopes.add(s);
770                scopes.addAll(superChain(s));
771                for (ClaferSymbol scope : scopes) {
772                    for (ClaferSymbol x : scope.lexicalChildren) {
773                        if (child == null && x.name().equals(n)) {
774                            child = x;
775                        }
776                    }
777                }
778                if (child == null) {
779                    error(id.span(), "No superclafer found: " + s.name() + " has no child " + n
780                            + ", neither its own nor an inherited one, for " + text);
781                    return null;
782                }
783                s = child;
784            }
785            if (s == c) {
786                error(path.span(), "clafer " + c.uid + " inherits from itself");
787                return null;
788            }
789            if (!s.isAbstract) {
790                error(path.span(), "No superclafer found: " + text + " is not abstract, and only abstract clafers can be supers");
791                return null;
792            }
793            return s;
794        }
795
796        private static boolean pathNames(Exp exp, List<ClaferId> names) {
797            return switch (exp) {
798                case ClaferId id -> names.add(id);
799                case Binary b when b.op() == BinaryOp.Join -> pathNames(b.left(), names) && pathNames(b.right(), names);
800                default -> false;
801            };
802        }
803
804        private static String path(ClaferSymbol c) {
805            List<String> names = new ArrayList<>();
806            for (ClaferSymbol a = c; a != null; a = a.lexicalParent) {
807                names.add(0, a.name());
808            }
809            return String.join(".", names);
810        }
811
812        private void checkCycles() {
813            for (ClaferSymbol c : all) {
814                Set<ClaferSymbol> visited = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
815                for (ClaferSymbol s = c.superClafer; s != null && visited.add(s); s = s.superClafer) {
816                    if (s == c) {
817                        error(c.declaration.span(), "clafer " + c.uid + " inherits from itself");
818                        break;
819                    }
820                }
821            }
822        }
823
824        /**
825         * A top-level abstract clafer that extends a nested abstract clafer
826         * becomes a sibling of its super (gsdlab/clafer#67): it goes after
827         * the children of its super's parent.
828         */
829        private void relocate() {
830            List<ClaferSymbol> moved = new ArrayList<>();
831            for (ClaferSymbol c : topLevel) {
832                if (c.isAbstract && c.superClafer != null && c.superClafer.lexicalParent != null) {
833                    moved.add(c);
834                }
835            }
836            for (ClaferSymbol c : moved) {
837                topLevel.remove(c);
838                c.parent = c.superClafer.lexicalParent;
839                c.parent.children.add(c);
840            }
841        }
842
843        // --------------------------------------------------------------
844        // References, as ResolverInheritance.resolveOReference
845        // --------------------------------------------------------------
846        private void resolveReference(ClaferSymbol c) {
847            if (c.writtenReference.isEmpty()) {
848                return;
849            }
850            Syntax.Reference r = c.writtenReference.get();
851            Exp target = r.exp();
852            boolean isSet = !r.bag();
853            Optional<String> constant = constantType(target);
854            if (constant.isPresent()) {
855                c.reference = new Reference(target.span(), isSet, target, Optional.empty(), constant);
856                c.referenceIds = List.of(constant.get());
857                return;
858            }
859            List<Type> leaves = new ArrayList<>();
860            boolean setExp = target instanceof Binary b && isSetOp(b.op());
861            if (!typesOf(c, target, leaves)) {
862                c.reference = new Reference(target.span(), isSet, target, Optional.empty(), Optional.empty());
863                return;
864            }
865            c.referenceIds = leaves.stream().map(t -> t.clafer().map(ClaferSymbol::uid).orElseGet(() -> t.primitive().get()))
866                    .toList();
867            Optional<Type> type = setExp ? setExpType(leaves) : leaves.size() == 1 ? Optional.of(leaves.get(0)) : Optional.empty();
868            c.reference = new Reference(target.span(), isSet, target,
869                    type.flatMap(Type::clafer), type.flatMap(Type::primitive));
870        }
871
872        private record Type(Optional<ClaferSymbol> clafer, Optional<String> primitive) {
873
874            static Type of(ClaferSymbol c) {
875                return new Type(Optional.of(c), Optional.empty());
876            }
877
878            static Type of(String primitive) {
879                return new Type(Optional.empty(), Optional.of(primitive));
880            }
881        }
882
883        private static boolean isSetOp(BinaryOp op) {
884            return op == BinaryOp.Union || op == BinaryOp.UnionCom || op == BinaryOp.Difference
885                    || op == BinaryOp.Intersection || op == BinaryOp.IntersectionDeprecated;
886        }
887
888        /**
889         * The types of the values of a target, as the compiler's
890         * {@code getRefIds}: of each operand of a set operator, and of the
891         * last name of a path.
892         */
893        private boolean typesOf(ClaferSymbol c, Exp exp, List<Type> types) {
894            Optional<String> constant = constantType(exp);
895            if (constant.isPresent()) {
896                types.add(Type.of(constant.get()));
897                return true;
898            }
899            switch (exp) {
900                case Binary b when isSetOp(b.op()) -> {
901                    return typesOf(c, b.left(), types) && typesOf(c, b.right(), types);
902                }
903                case Binary b when b.op() == BinaryOp.Join -> {
904                    List<ClaferId> names = new ArrayList<>();
905                    if (!pathNames(b, names)) {
906                        error(exp.span(), "A reference's target must be a name, a path or a set expression");
907                        return false;
908                    }
909                    Optional<Type> t = resolveFirst(c, names.get(0));
910                    for (ClaferId id : names.subList(1, names.size())) {
911                        if (t.isEmpty() || t.get().clafer().isEmpty()) {
912                            if (t.isPresent()) {
913                                error(id.span(), "Name resolver: '" + last(id) + "' not found");
914                            }
915                            return false;
916                        }
917                        t = resolveChild(t.get().clafer().get(), id);
918                    }
919                    t.ifPresent(types::add);
920                    return t.isPresent();
921                }
922                case ClaferId id -> {
923                    Optional<Type> t = resolveFirst(c, id);
924                    t.ifPresent(types::add);
925                    return t.isPresent();
926                }
927                default -> {
928                    error(exp.span(), "A reference's target must be a name, a path or a set expression");
929                    return false;
930                }
931            }
932        }
933
934        /**
935         * The first name of a target: a primitive, or the unique clafer with
936         * the name in the trees of the top-level abstract clafers, or else of
937         * the concrete ones, inherited children included, as the compiler's
938         * {@code resolveTopLevel}.
939         */
940        private Optional<Type> resolveFirst(ClaferSymbol c, ClaferId id) {
941            String name = last(id);
942            if (Primitives.contains(name)) {
943                return Optional.of(Type.of(name));
944            }
945            if (Specials.contains(name)) {
946                error(id.span(), "A reference's target cannot be '" + name + "'");
947                return Optional.empty();
948            }
949            for (boolean abstractTrees : new boolean[]{true, false}) {
950                List<List<ClaferSymbol>> found = new ArrayList<>();
951                for (List<ClaferSymbol> p : bfs(abstractTrees)) {
952                    if (p.get(0).name().equals(name)) {
953                        found.add(p);
954                    }
955                }
956                if (found.size() == 1) {
957                    return Optional.of(Type.of(found.get(0).get(0)));
958                }
959                if (found.size() > 1) {
960                    error(id.span(), "clafer \"" + name + "\" is not unique. Available paths: "
961                            + found.stream().map(Analysis::showPath).distinct().collect(Collectors.joining(", ")));
962                    return Optional.empty();
963                }
964            }
965            error(id.span(), "Name resolver: '" + name + "' not found");
966            return Optional.empty();
967        }
968
969        private static String showPath(List<ClaferSymbol> path) {
970            List<String> uids = path.stream().map(ClaferSymbol::uid).collect(Collectors.toList());
971            Collections.reverse(uids);
972            return String.join(".", uids);
973        }
974
975        /**
976         * The paths, nearest clafer first, of the clafers in the trees of the
977         * top-level abstract or concrete clafers, breadth first, through the
978         * children and the inherited children; a path stops at a clafer that
979         * it reaches a second time.
980         */
981        private List<List<ClaferSymbol>> bfs(boolean abstractTrees) {
982            List<List<ClaferSymbol>> out = new ArrayList<>();
983            Deque<List<ClaferSymbol>> queue = new ArrayDeque<>();
984            for (ClaferSymbol t : topLevel) {
985                if (t.isAbstract == abstractTrees) {
986                    queue.add(List.of(t));
987                }
988            }
989            Set<List<ClaferSymbol>> seen = new HashSet<>();
990            while (!queue.isEmpty()) {
991                List<ClaferSymbol> p = queue.poll();
992                if (seen.add(p)) {
993                    out.add(p);
994                }
995                ClaferSymbol c = p.get(0);
996                if (Collections.frequency(p, c) > 1) {
997                    continue;
998                }
999                for (ClaferSymbol child : inheritedChildren(c)) {
1000                    List<ClaferSymbol> q = new ArrayList<>();
1001                    q.add(child);
1002                    q.addAll(p);
1003                    queue.add(q);
1004                }
1005            }
1006            return out;
1007        }
1008
1009        /**
1010         * The children of the clafer and of its supers.
1011         */
1012        private List<ClaferSymbol> inheritedChildren(ClaferSymbol c) {
1013            List<ClaferSymbol> out = new ArrayList<>(c.children);
1014            for (ClaferSymbol s : superChain(c)) {
1015                out.addAll(s.children);
1016            }
1017            return out;
1018        }
1019
1020        /**
1021         * The next name of a path: a child of the clafer, its own or an
1022         * inherited one, or else a child of its reference's target.
1023         */
1024        private Optional<Type> resolveChild(ClaferSymbol c, ClaferId id) {
1025            String name = last(id);
1026            Set<ClaferSymbol> own = new LinkedHashSet<>();
1027            for (ClaferSymbol x : inheritedChildren(c)) {
1028                if (x.name().equals(name)) {
1029                    own.add(x);
1030                }
1031            }
1032            if (own.isEmpty()) {
1033                Set<ClaferSymbol> visited = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
1034                for (ClaferSymbol t = c; t != null && visited.add(t); ) {
1035                    if (t.writtenReference.isPresent() && t.reference == null && t != c) {
1036                        resolveReference(t);
1037                    }
1038                    ClaferSymbol target = null;
1039                    for (ClaferSymbol s : withSupers(t)) {
1040                        if (s.reference != null && s.reference.clafer().isPresent()) {
1041                            target = s.reference.clafer().get();
1042                            break;
1043                        }
1044                    }
1045                    t = target;
1046                    if (t != null) {
1047                        for (ClaferSymbol x : inheritedChildren(t)) {
1048                            if (x.name().equals(name)) {
1049                                own.add(x);
1050                            }
1051                        }
1052                    }
1053                }
1054            }
1055            if (own.size() == 1) {
1056                return Optional.of(Type.of(own.iterator().next()));
1057            }
1058            error(id.span(), own.isEmpty()
1059                    ? "Name resolver: '" + name + "' not found within " + c.uid
1060                    : "clafer \"" + name + "\" is not unique in " + c.uid);
1061            return Optional.empty();
1062        }
1063
1064        private List<ClaferSymbol> withSupers(ClaferSymbol c) {
1065            List<ClaferSymbol> out = new ArrayList<>();
1066            out.add(c);
1067            out.addAll(superChain(c));
1068            return out;
1069        }
1070
1071        /**
1072         * The type of a set expression, as the compiler's
1073         * {@code setExpType}: the primitive of its values, with integers
1074         * among decimals as decimals, or the nearest common super of its
1075         * clafers.
1076         */
1077        private Optional<Type> setExpType(List<Type> leaves) {
1078            if (leaves.stream().allMatch(t -> t.primitive().isPresent())) {
1079                Set<String> types = new java.util.TreeSet<>();
1080                for (Type t : leaves) {
1081                    types.add(t.primitive().get().equals("int") ? "integer" : t.primitive().get());
1082                }
1083                if (types.size() == 1) {
1084                    return Optional.of(Type.of(types.iterator().next()));
1085                }
1086                if (types.equals(Set.of("decimal", "integer"))) {
1087                    return Optional.of(Type.of("decimal"));
1088                }
1089                return Optional.empty();
1090            }
1091            if (leaves.stream().allMatch(t -> t.clafer().isPresent())) {
1092                List<List<ClaferSymbol>> supers = leaves.stream().map(t -> withSupers(t.clafer().get())).toList();
1093                for (ClaferSymbol u : supers.get(0)) {
1094                    if (supers.stream().allMatch(s -> s.contains(u))) {
1095                        return Optional.of(Type.of(u));
1096                    }
1097                }
1098            }
1099            return Optional.empty();
1100        }
1101
1102        // --------------------------------------------------------------
1103        // Cards, as ResolverInheritance.analyzeModule
1104        // --------------------------------------------------------------
1105        private void analyzeCards(ClaferSymbol c, ClaferSymbol parent) {
1106            c.groupCard = c.writtenGroupCard.orElse(null);
1107            if (c.groupCard == null && c.superClafer != null) {
1108                for (ClaferSymbol s : superChain(c)) {
1109                    if (s.writtenGroupCard.isPresent()) {
1110                        c.groupCard = s.writtenGroupCard.get();
1111                        break;
1112                    }
1113                }
1114            }
1115            if (c.groupCard == null) {
1116                c.groupCard = GroupCard.Default;
1117            }
1118            if (c.writtenCard.isPresent()) {
1119                c.card = c.writtenCard.get();
1120            } else if (c.isAbstract) {
1121                c.card = Interval.Any;
1122            } else if (parent == null || parent.groupCard.equals(GroupCard.Default)) {
1123                // mandatory at the top level and under the default group; optional under a
1124                // keyword group (opt included) or a numeric one
1125                c.card = Interval.One;
1126            } else {
1127                c.card = Interval.Lone;
1128            }
1129            for (ClaferSymbol child : c.children) {
1130                analyzeCards(child, c);
1131            }
1132        }
1133
1134        /**
1135         * The UID of the parent as the compiler's {@code _parentUID}: the
1136         * root of a top-level clafer is {@code root}, and that of a
1137         * top-level abstract one {@code clafer}.
1138         */
1139        private static String parentUid(ClaferSymbol c) {
1140            return c.parent != null ? c.parent.uid : c.isAbstract ? "clafer" : "root";
1141        }
1142
1143        /**
1144         * A primitive and the primitives it converts to, as the compiler's
1145         * hierarchy of primitives: an integer is a decimal, a decimal and a
1146         * double are reals.
1147         */
1148        private static List<String> primitiveSupers(String p) {
1149            return switch (p) {
1150                case "integer", "int" -> List.of(p, "decimal", "real");
1151                case "decimal", "double" -> List.of(p, "real");
1152                default -> List.of(p);
1153            };
1154        }
1155
1156        private List<String> supersOfId(String id) {
1157            if (Primitives.contains(id)) {
1158                return primitiveSupers(id);
1159            }
1160            return all.stream().filter(s -> s.uid.equals(id)).findFirst()
1161                    .map(s -> withSupers(s).stream().map(x -> x.uid).toList()).orElse(List.of(id));
1162        }
1163
1164        /**
1165         * The nesting and the redefinition of a clafer with a super, as the
1166         * compiler's {@code resolveRedefinition}: a super that is nested
1167         * belongs to the parent, or to a super of the parent's super; a
1168         * concrete super's card is narrowed; a set reference stays a set; the
1169         * target is a subtype of the super's target.
1170         */
1171        private void checkRedefinition(ClaferSymbol c) {
1172            ClaferSymbol s = c.superClafer;
1173            if (s == null || c.isEnum) {
1174                return;
1175            }
1176            String superParent = parentUid(s);
1177            boolean properNesting = (s.parent == null && s.isAbstract)
1178                    || parentUid(c).equals(superParent)
1179                    || (c.parent != null && c.parent.superClafer != null
1180                    && withSupers(c.parent.superClafer).stream().anyMatch(x -> x.uid.equals(superParent)));
1181            String problem = null;
1182            if (!properNesting) {
1183                problem = "Improperly nested clafer";
1184            } else if (!s.isAbstract && !(c.card.low() >= s.card.low()
1185                    && (c.card.high() <= s.card.high() || s.card.high() == Interval.Unbounded))) {
1186                problem = "Improper cardinality refinement for clafer";
1187            } else if (c.reference != null && s.reference != null && s.reference.isSet() && !c.reference.isSet()) {
1188                problem = "Improper bag to set refinement for clafer";
1189            } else if (c.referenceIds.size() == 1 && s.referenceIds.size() == 1) {
1190                String target = c.referenceIds.get(0);
1191                String superTarget = s.referenceIds.get(0);
1192                if (!supersOfId(target).contains(superTarget)
1193                        && !((target.equals("integer") || target.equals("int")) && superTarget.equals("double"))) {
1194                    problem = "Improper target subtyping for clafer";
1195                }
1196            }
1197            if (problem != null) {
1198                error(c.declaration.span(), problem + " '" + c.name() + "'");
1199            }
1200        }
1201
1202        /**
1203         * A concrete clafer's group card can be satisfied: its children, the
1204         * inherited ones included, can have as many instances as its lower
1205         * bound, as the compiler's {@code unsatisfiableGroups}, e.g.,
1206         * {@code xor} over no children.
1207         */
1208        private void checkGroup(ClaferSymbol c) {
1209            int low = c.groupCard.interval().low();
1210            if (c.isAbstract || low <= 0) {
1211                return;
1212            }
1213            long most = 0;
1214            for (ClaferSymbol child : inheritedChildren(c)) {
1215                if (child.card.high() == Interval.Unbounded) {
1216                    return;
1217                }
1218                most += child.card.high();
1219            }
1220            if (most < low) {
1221                error(c.declaration.span(), "The group cardinality " + c.groupCard.interval() + " of " + c.name()
1222                        + " cannot be satisfied: its children, including the inherited ones, can have at most "
1223                        + most + " instances");
1224            }
1225        }
1226
1227        private void checkDuplicateSiblings(List<ClaferSymbol> siblings) {
1228            // at the first clafer with the name, as the compiler reports it
1229            Map<String, ClaferSymbol> seen = new HashMap<>();
1230            Set<ClaferSymbol> reported = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
1231            for (ClaferSymbol s : siblings) {
1232                ClaferSymbol first = seen.putIfAbsent(s.name(), s);
1233                if (first != null && reported.add(first)) {
1234                    error(first.declaration.span(), "Duplicate name: " + s.name());
1235                }
1236                checkDuplicateSiblings(s.children);
1237            }
1238        }
1239    }
1240
1241    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
1242    // The outline
1243    // ------------------------------------------------------------------
1244    /**
1245     * The clafers as the explicit form declares them, without their
1246     * constraints and the values of their initializers: one line per clafer,
1247     * {@code [abstract] [modifiers] gcard uid [: super] [-> type] card [init]},
1248     * its subclafers indented under it, and an enumeration as
1249     * {@code enum E = a | b}. It is what the symbols say about a model, and
1250     * {@link #outline(Ir.Model)} gives the same for an explicit model.
1251     *
1252     * @param symbols the symbols of a model
1253     * @return its outline
1254     */
1255    public static String outline(Result symbols) {
1256        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
1257        for (ClaferSymbol c : symbols.topLevel()) {
1258            if (c.isEnum()) {
1259                if (c.isAbstract()) {
1260                    out.append("enum ").append(c.uid()).append(" = ").append(symbols.topLevel().stream()
1261                            .filter(l -> l.isEnum() && l.superClafer().orElse(null) == c)
1262                            .map(ClaferSymbol::uid).collect(Collectors.joining(" | "))).append('\n');
1263                }
1264            } else {
1265                outline(c, "", out);
1266            }
1267        }
1268        return out.toString();
1269    }
1270
1271    private static void outline(ClaferSymbol c, String indent, StringBuilder out) {
1272        out.append(indent);
1273        if (c.isAbstract()) {
1274            out.append("abstract ");
1275        }
1276        if (c.isInitial()) {
1277            out.append("initial ");
1278        }
1279        if (c.isFinal()) {
1280            out.append("final ");
1281        } else {
1282            for (RefModifier m : c.refModifiers()) {
1283                out.append(m.keyword()).append(' ');
1284            }
1285        }
1286        out.append(printedGroupCard(c)).append(' ').append(c.uid());
1287        c.superClafer().ifPresent(s -> out.append(" : ").append(s.uid()));
1288        c.reference().filter(Reference::hasType)
1289                .ifPresent(r -> out.append(r.isSet() ? " -> " : " ->> ").append(r.typeName()));
1290        out.append(' ').append(c.card());
1291        c.initializer().ifPresent(i -> out.append(' ').append(i.syntax()));
1292        out.append('\n');
1293        for (ClaferSymbol child : c.children()) {
1294            outline(child, indent + "  ", out);
1295        }
1296    }
1297
1298    /**
1299     * The group card as the explicit form prints it: the clafer's, unless it
1300     * is {@code 0..*}, and then its super's.
1301     */
1302    static Interval printedGroupCard(ClaferSymbol c) {
1303        Set<ClaferSymbol> visited = Collections.newSetFromMap(new IdentityHashMap<>());
1304        for (ClaferSymbol s = c; s != null && visited.add(s); s = s.superClafer().orElse(null)) {
1305            if (!s.groupCard().interval().equals(Interval.Any)) {
1306                return s.groupCard().interval();
1307            }
1308        }
1309        return Interval.Any;
1310    }
1311
1312    /**
1313     * @param model an explicit model
1314     * @return its outline, as {@link #outline(Result)}
1315     */
1316    public static String outline(Ir.Model model) {
1317        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
1318        for (Ir.Element e : model.elements()) {
1319            switch (e) {
1320                case Ir.EnumDecl en -> out.append("enum ").append(en.name().text()).append(" = ")
1321                        .append(en.literals().stream().map(Ir.Name::text).collect(Collectors.joining(" | ")))
1322                        .append('\n');
1323                case Ir.ClaferDecl c -> outline(c, "", out);
1324                default -> {
1325                }
1326            }
1327        }
1328        return out.toString();
1329    }
1330
1331    private static void outline(Ir.ClaferDecl c, String indent, StringBuilder out) {
1332        out.append(indent);
1333        if (c.isAbstract()) {
1334            out.append("abstract ");
1335        }
1336        for (Ir.Modifier m : c.modifiers()) {
1337            out.append(m.kind().keyword()).append(' ');
1338        }
1339        out.append(c.groupCard()).append(' ').append(c.name().text());
1340        c.superName().ifPresent(s -> out.append(" : ").append(s.text()));
1341        c.ref().ifPresent(r -> out.append(r.isSet() ? " -> " : " ->> ").append(r.target().text()));
1342        out.append(' ').append(c.abstractMultiplicity().map(Ir.AbstractMultiplicity::card).orElse(c.card()));
1343        c.initializer().ifPresent(i -> out.append(' ').append(i.kind().syntax()));
1344        out.append('\n');
1345        for (Ir.Element e : c.elements()) {
1346            if (e instanceof Ir.ClaferDecl child) {
1347                outline(child, indent + "  ", out);
1348            }
1349        }
1350    }
1351}
